fact: A 7 November 2024 workshop by CGAP, OQSF-CI and APIF on a survey run 10-29 August 2024 found providers' availability to receive client concerns and complaints about digital financial services rose from 33% in 2022 to 78% in 2024.
title: CÔTE D'IVOIRE - ANALYSE COMPARATIVE DES RISQUES LIÉS AUX SERVICES FINANCIERS NUMÉRIQUES ENTRE 2022 ET 2024
